recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future binding or value-set changes for capabilitystatement-expectation should be made in the FHIR Extension Pack or THO; core should only update external links if those locations change.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive R5 FHIR-core technical correction requesting that the capabilitystatement-expectation extension bind to http://terminology.hl7.org/ValueSet/conformance-expectation instead of http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/conformance-expectation.
initial_application: No current FHIR-core commit explicitly mentions FHIR-37596. The Jira-cited Git c31b31e is in HL7/fhir-extensions and changed StructureDefinition-capabilitystatement-expectation.xml to the THO ValueSet. Core history had already moved R5 extension definitions out of FHIR-core and later adjusted core narrative links to use the external extensions location.
additional_context: FHIR-I WGM minutes recorded that the CodeSystem and ValueSet would live only in THO for this issue. Current FHIR-core source has no local StructureDefinition-capabilitystatement-expectation definition and only links to the external extension. Later issues FHIR-40228, FHIR-29593, and FHIR-44609 distinguish the broader Requirements conformance terminology and SHALL-NOT/prohibition handling from this Extension Pack binding.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit on the combined FHIR-core branch. No core source was changed because the artifact requested by the issue is outside the current core checkout and is already correct in the Extension Pack.
